description: Synthetic records of one fictional person's photo library (Maya Fenwick) with fictional relatives and friends, for reproducible acceptance; not a benchmark task. Workflow shapes were informed by Google Photos Help (https://support.google.com/photos/) for shared albums, link sharing, storage and trash, and by the Immich documentation (https://docs.immich.app/) for albums, stacks, shared links and trash; no data, text, photos, branding or icons were taken from them.

sources.description: Hand-authored synthetic records; no external collection. People, places and captions are fictional.
Stand-in PNG images drawn by dev/draw-images.cjs: flat scenes of colour fields and shapes with light grain and a stamped caption. No people, faces, photographs or generative model.

parameters.seed_from: FNV-1a hash of the item ID

transformations: Timestamps carry explicit UTC offsets; local days are resolved in America/Los_Angeles.
Records and images are generated by scripts/build-reference-fixture.cjs with a fixed pseudo-random seed; fixtures/minimal.json is hand-authored.

review.notes: Automated checks do not replace human review of realism (library size and metadata, notification wording), of whether the script-drawn stand-in images are adequate, and of the fictional status of every person and place.
